docs.title: Installation
docs.text:
pip install inferkit              # lightweight core
pip install inferkit[vision]      # + Pillow
pip install inferkit[torch,transformers]

docs.title: Text (Simplest - 3 lines)
docs.text:
from inferkit import infer
@infer
async def run(payload, files=None):
    return {"output": payload.get("text","")}
# sync is also supported:
# @infer
# def run(payload): return {"output": "sync"}

docs.title: Vision (Image Input)
docs.text:
from inferkit import infer
from PIL import Image
import io
@infer
async def run(payload, files=None):
    if not files: return {"error": "no image"}
    img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(files[0]))
    return {"output": f"cat detected {img.size}"}
# client: curl -F payload='{"text":"hi"}' -F files=@cat.jpg http://localhost:8000/api/v1/infer

docs.title: Generation (Image Output - Recommended)
docs.text:
from inferkit import infer, image_to_base64
from PIL import Image
@infer
async def run(payload, files=None):
    img = Image.new("RGB", (512,512), "red")
    return image_to_base64(img)  # {"image_base64": ..., "media_type": "image/png"}
# manual method also works:
# import base64, io; buf=io.BytesIO(); img.save(buf,format="PNG"); return {"image_base64": base64.b64encode(buf.getvalue()).decode()}
# or raw bytes: return buf.getvalue()

docs.title: Audio
docs.text:
from inferkit import infer
@infer
async def run(payload, files=None):
    if not files: return {"error": "no audio"}
    audio_bytes = files[0]  # wav/mp3 bytes
    return {"transcript": "...", "bytes": len(audio_bytes)}

docs.title: LLM Streaming
docs.text:
from inferkit import infer
@infer.stream
async def run_stream(payload):
    for tok in llm.stream(payload["text"]):
        yield tok
# sync generator also supported:
# @infer.stream
# def run_stream(payload):
#     for tok in payload["text"].split(): yield tok

Client: - REST SSE: POST /api/v1/infer/stream with {"text":"hello","stream":true} -> data: {"token": "..."} + data: [DONE] - WebSocket: WS /ws/infer with {"text":"hi","stream":true} or {"text":"hi"}

docs.title: Large Files
docs.text: .env: INFERKIT_MAX_UPLOAD_MB=50 (or MAX_UPLOAD_MB). Limit is checked on both Content-Length and len(bytes), returns 413.

docs.title: Authentication
docs.text: .env: INFERKIT_API_KEY=secret -> client X-API-Key: secret or ?api_key=secret (for WS)

docs.title: Environment Configuration (.env)
docs.text:
INFERKIT_HOST=0.0.0.0
INFERKIT_PORT=8000
INFERKIT_CORS_ORIGINS=["*"]   # or * or http://a.com,http://b.com
INFERKIT_MAX_UPLOAD_MB=50
INFERKIT_RATE_LIMIT=60/minute
INFERKIT_API_KEY=
INFERKIT_DEBUG=false
# plain names HOST/PORT/... also supported for backwards compatibility

docs.title: Optional Dependencies
docs.text:
pip install inferkit[vision]        # Pillow
pip install inferkit[torch]         # torch+torchvision
pip install inferkit[transformers]  # transformers+accelerate
pip install inferkit[all]           # all extras
pip install inferkit[dev]           # pytest, ruff, mypy

docs.title: Port and Firewall
docs.text:
If port 8000 is busy (Not Found or Address already in use):

inferkit serve inference.py --port 8001
# or
INFERKIT_PORT=8001 inferkit serve inference.py

Windows Firewall:

New-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName "InferKit 8001" -Direction Inbound -LocalPort 8001 -Protocol TCP -Action Allow

Linux:

sudo ufw allow 8001/tcp

docs.title: Testing via Swagger
docs.text:
Open http://localhost:8000/docs:

  • GET /health -> Try it out -> Execute -> {"status":"ok"}
  • POST /api/v1/infer/json -> body {"features":[5.1,3.5,1.4,0.2]} -> Execute
  • POST /api/v1/infer/stream -> {"text":"hello world"} for SSE

docs.title: Endpoints
docs.text: Method Path Auth Description GET / - Welcome + has_model GET /health - Health check GET /metrics - {"requests": int, "model_loaded": bool} GET /api/v1/info - Model info POST /api/v1/infer X-API-Key if set multipart/form-data: payload (JSON string) + files (multiple files). Limit 413 POST /api/v1/infer/json X-API-Key application/json body. Limit 1MB POST /api/v1/infer/stream X-API-Key SSE text/event-stream: data: {"token": ...} + data: [DONE] WS /ws/infer X-API-Key header or ?api_key= WebSocket: send {"text":"hi"} or {"text":"hi","stream":true}, receive {"output":...} or {"token":...} + {"done":true} WS /api/v1/ws/infer same Alias for WS

docs.title: curl Examples
docs.text:
# JSON
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/infer/json -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"text":"hello"}'

# File
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/infer -F payload='{"text":"hi"}' -F files=@cat.jpg

# SSE
curl -N -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/infer/stream -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"text":"hello world"}'

# WS (wscat)
wscat -c ws://localhost:8000/ws/infer
> {"text":"hello","stream":true}
< {"token":"hello "}

docs.title: Errors
docs.text:
• 400 Invalid JSON or payload not an object
  • 401 Invalid API key
  • 413 Payload/file too large
  • 429 Rate limit (60/minute default)
  • 500 No model registered or inference error (generic message when DEBUG=false)

docs.title: Rate Limit
docs.text: Uses slowapi with INFERKIT_RATE_LIMIT. Response 429 {"error":"rate limit exceeded"}

docs.title: CORS
docs.text: INFERKIT_CORS_ORIGINS=["*"] -> allow_credentials=False (automatic). For specific domain: ["http://a.com"] -> allow_credentials=True

docs.title: Vision
docs.text: This example shows how to handle image input and output.

docs.title: Input
docs.text:
from inferkit import infer
from PIL import Image
import io

@infer
async def run(payload, files=None):
    if not files:
        return {"error": "no image"}
    img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(files[0]))
    w, h = img.size
    return {"output": f"image {w}x{h}", "boxes": []}

See examples/vision/yolo_example.py.

docs.title: Output
docs.text:
from inferkit import infer, image_to_base64
from PIL import Image

@infer
async def run(payload, files=None):
    img = Image.new("RGB", (512, 512), "red")
    return image_to_base64(img)

Raw bytes are also supported: return png_bytes.
